triple_arch_ritual_paragraph: One pink page leaves a white copy stack. Thursday at ten is written in the margin and a pen travels across the counter. For one beat every blank sheet in the machine seems like a future waiting to take color, then the chosen adult writes one ordinary name beside Sunna's. Clavinet teeth, paper feed, stopped claps and clipped guitar leave the afterimage of frivolity doing the work of hope.
